source_verification.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#An illusion appears around #Target# making %s appear human.
This small pendant depicts a hematite moon eclipsing a golden sun and according to legend was worn by one of the Sunwall's founders.
Freed Derth from the onslaught of the mad Tempest, Urkis.
I know, I know. Where does the eel stop and the tail start? It doesn't much matter. The last ten inches or so should do nicely.

Corrupted vapour rises at the target location (radius 4) doing %0.2f blight damage every turn for %d turns.
		The damage increases with Spellpower.

Your body is more like that of an ooze.
		When you take damage, you may split and create a Bloated Ooze nearby within your line of sight.
		This ooze has as much health as twice the damage you took (up to a maximum of %d, based on your Mindpower and maximum life).
		The chance to split equals the percent of your health lost times %0.2f.
		You may have up to %d Bloated Oozes active at any time (limited by talent level and the summoning limit), and all damage you take will be split equally between you and them so long as this talent is active.
		Bloated Oozes last for %d turns, are very resilient (%d%% all damage resistance to damage not coming through your shared link), and regenerate life quickly.
		%sThe chance to split increases with your Cunning.
Through rigorous training, you have learned to focus your actions for a short while, increasing your speed by %d%% for 5 turns.
You have been tasked to remove at least one of the threats to the yeeks.
This cracked gemstone looks faded with age. It appears to have once been the eye of a golem.

#GOLD#Flat resistances#LAST#
Reduces each hit of a certain damage type (or all) by this amount.

You summon a river of tortured souls to launch an onslaught of darkness against your foes.
		Every turn for 5 turns you launch a projectile towards the designated area that explodes in radius %d, dealing %0.2f darkness damage.
		Each projectile consumes a soul and the spell ends when it has sent 5 projectiles or when you have no more souls to use.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
stair back to the lake of Nur
You have heard that near the Charred Scar, to the south, lies a ruined tower known as the Dreadfell.
Aeryn, I am sorry but one of us needs to be sacrificed for the world to go on. #LIGHT_GREEN#[sacrifice Aeryn for the sake of the world]

Too late! Argh, too late. %s has already finished. I'll make the elixir and reward you as promised, but only because the Brotherhood breaks the fingers of non-member alchemists who rook people. Members, on the other hand...
#VIOLET#Your rod of recall glows brightly for a moment.
Did over 1500 damage in one attack.
Unleash nature's fury against foes around you.

Enter a fluid, mobile shooting stance that excels at close combat. Your ranged attack speed is increased by %d%% and each time you shoot you gain %d%% increased movement speed for 2 turns.
Ranged attacks against targets will also grant you up to %d%% of a turn. This is 100%% effective against targets within 3 tiles, and decreases by 20%% for each tile beyond that (to 0%% at 8 tiles). This cannot occur more than once per turn.
Requires a sling to use.

An arcane vortex follows the target. Each turn a manathrust fires from it to a random foe in sight doing %0.2f arcane damage to all. If no foes are found the main target takes 50%% more arcane damage this turn. If the target dies the remaining damage is dealt as a radius 2 ball of arcane.
#YELLOW#Items lying around will disappear in #WHITE#%d#YELLOW# turns!#LAST#
Taking on a spectral form, allowing teleportation back to their original tile.
You literally dance around your foes, increasing your movement speed by %d%% and reducing the cooldown of Hack'n'Back, Rush, Disengage and Evasion by %d turns.
Some do not walk upon the straight road others follow. Seek the hidden paths outside the normal course of life.
%s go to the west, and find Kruk Pride!
#VIOLET#Another foe is summoned to the arena!
Became the new master of the arena in 60-wave mode.
* #LIGHT_GREEN#%d%%#LAST# chance to reduce strength, dexterity, and constitution by #VIOLET#%d#LAST#%s
Player can earn Madness version of achievements if also playing in Roguelike or Adventure permadeath mode.
You cannot pick up items from the floor while asleep!
There are no shadows to heed the call!
Increases the accuracy of unarmed, melee and ranged weapons by %d.
This creature has fallen into a solipsistic state and is caught up in its own egoic thoughts (-%d%% global speed).

Grants %d Physical Power when fighting unarmed (or with gloves or gauntlets).
		This talent's effects will scale with your level.
You have laid Celia to rest, putting an end to her failed experiments. You have taken her heart, for your own experiments. You do not plan to fail as she did.
Prepare which traps? (maximum: %d, up to tier %d)%s

50%% chance that damage the caster takes will be warped to a set target.
		Once the maximum damage (%d) is absorbed, the time runs out, or the target dies, the shield will crumble.
A stream of poison gushes onto @target@!
